# The target module documents classes that a module built later relates
# its non-members to, using additional \relates commands (QTBUG-116182).
# It is built first, so that the user module resolves those \relates
# targets from its index file and records the relationships in its own
# index file. The target module is then built again as the consumer,
# loading the user module's index file, similar to how a module with
# `depends = *` is built. The expected output proves that the target's
# reference pages link to the related non-members documented in the
# user module.
upstream_relates_target
relates_user
multiple_relates_index
